result.title: Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology
result.summary: Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. We introduce Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining (LIMIT), which addresses this gap by freezing a pretrained vision encoder and fine-tuning only the text encoder: report embeddings serve as cross-attention queries over bags of patch features, producing report-conditioned slide representations optimized via InfoNCE. Using LIMIT, we establish CONCH-Z, which aligns the text encoder of CONCH v1.5 to 335k clinical reports. Evaluated across 22 tasks spanning patch-level classification, tumor detection, and slide-level subtyping, CONCH-Z establishes state-of-the-art zero-shot performance over VL encoders trained on curated caption datasets, while simultaneously closing the gap with slide-level foundation models trained with substantially more parameters and compute. The code and model is available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LIMIT：冻结预训练视觉编码器、只微调文本编码器，让病理报告嵌入作为 cross-attention query 对 patch 特征包做注意力聚合，得到报告条件化的 slide 表示并以 InfoNCE 对齐，据此构建 CONCH-Z，在 22 项病理任务上取得零样本 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 报告查询对 patch 特征包的 cross-attention 聚合与弱监督对齐，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、把 patch 级细节压缩进 latent 状态提供可核查的方法线索；冻结视觉塔也便于考察视觉旁路与信息坍缩，但论文本身不涉及推理过程。
